system.description:
Growing Unique (war hammer +1).

Dormant (when found, save DC 13): when a hit deals damage, you may take 1d6 psychic yourself to deal +2d6 bludgeoning.

Awakened (bearer 9th level, save DC 15): the hammer is +2; once per day, slam the ground: each creature within 30ft makes a Fortitude save or is knocked Prone.

Exalted (bearer 17th level, save DC 17): the hammer is +3; once per day, cast earthquake centred on you.

Monsters & Treasure, Growing Uniques. Each state adds to the one before. It falls back to Dormant with a new bearer. Its bonus is +1 Dormant, +2 Awakened and +3 Exalted: raise it on the item when it wakes.
